description: Returns the natural logarithm of a positive finite number. Non-positive or non-finite inputs fail before a result is published.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Positive finite number whose natural logarithm should be returned. Non-positive or non-finite inputs fail before a result is published.

outputs.name: log
outputs.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the input.

description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a positive finite number. Non-positive or non-finite inputs fail before a result is published.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Positive finite number whose base-10 logarithm should be returned. Non-positive or non-finite inputs fail before a result is published.

outputs.name: log10
outputs.description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of the input.

description: Raises a finite base to a finite exponent. Non-finite inputs or results fail before a result is published.

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: Finite number to raise to the exponent.

inputs.name: exponent
inputs.description: Finite exponent applied to the base. Non-finite inputs or results fail before a result is published.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the base raised to the exponent.

description: Raises a finite base to a finite exponent using the power operation. Non-finite inputs or results fail before a result is published.

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: Finite number to raise to the exponent.

inputs.name: exponent
inputs.description: Finite exponent applied to the base. Non-finite inputs or results fail before a result is published.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the base raised to the exponent.

description: Rounds a finite number to the requested decimal places. Decimal places are clamped to [-15, 15] before rounding. Non-finite numeric inputs or results fail before a result is published.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Finite number to round. Non-finite numeric inputs or results fail before a result is published.

inputs.name: decimal_places
inputs.description: Number of decimal places to retain. Decimal places are clamped to [-15, 15] before rounding.
